steps.en: Install dependencies and build the CLI with its workspace resources
steps.zh: 安装依赖并构建 CLI 及工作区资源

steps.en: Configure a model provider and prepare an isolated project
steps.zh: 配置模型提供商，准备隔离项目

steps.en: Submit the task with an explicit permission mode
steps.zh: 提交任务，显式选择权限模式

steps.en: Call the model and execute its tools under that mode and enabled hooks
steps.zh: 调用模型，按模式和启用的 Hook 执行工具

steps.en: Return session and response data alongside observable file and command results
steps.zh: 返回会话和回答数据，留下可检查的文件与命令结果

value.en: Run coding tasks through one supplied runtime instead of writing the model/tool loop yourself
value.zh: 用自带运行时执行编程任务，不必自己拼模型与工具循环
